title.en: Newton basins for z cubed minus one

summary: Iterate Newton’s rule for f(z)=z^3-1 on a finite complex grid, classify only tolerance-confirmed roots, and lift one selected orbit without mistaking iteration count for time.
objective: Link three analytic roots, a finite basin raster and one exact recurrence while exposing derivative singularity, divergence and unresolved samples.
intent_signals: Build Newton basins for z^3-1 with a selected complex orbit and unresolved pixels.
example_prompts: Build Newton basins for z^3-1 with a selected complex orbit and unresolved pixels.
negative_signals: Not the quadratic Julia recurrence z^2+c.
Not proof that finite pixel boundaries equal an exact fractal boundary.
not_for: Arbitrary polynomials or certified root isolation.
Treating convergence speed as physical time.

entities.name: Finite basin floor
entities.guidance: Sample z0 at declared pixel centers; encode converged-to-root 0/1/2, singular, out-of-domain and unresolved with non-color cues.

entities.name: Three analytic root beacons
entities.guidance: Place roots 1, exp(2pi i/3), exp(4pi i/3) exactly on the complex plane.

entities.name: Selected orbit ladder
entities.guidance: Plot (Re z_n,Im z_n,n) with table, residual |z_n^3-1| and stop reason.

state_contract.model: For finite complex z0 in a bounded viewport, iterate z_(n+1)=z_n-(z_n^3-1)/(3z_n^2)=(2z_n^3+1)/(3z_n^2). Require 1<=N<=1000, finite tolerances 0<epsRoot<=0.1 and epsDeriv>0, and display bound R>1. At each stored z_n, first reject nonfinite arithmetic, then test each analytic root using both |z_n-rho_j|<=epsRoot and finite |z_n^3-1|<=epsRoot; only if none passes, test |3z_n^2|<=epsDeriv before division. Reject any nonfinite quotient or successor. Mark out-of-domain if |z_n|>R, without claiming divergence; otherwise continue or mark unresolved at N.
state_contract.authority: Complex recurrence and stop order own classification. Palette and extrusion cannot change it.
actions: Select z0 and step/play/scrub its stored orbit.
Adjust N,tolerances or viewport and recompute all samples.
Toggle roots, singular mask, residual table and boundary uncertainty.
Reset all numeric and view state.

invariants: Each classified root is one of the three analytic cube roots and passes the residual/tolerance check.
z0=0 triggers the derivative guard before division.
A sample that already passes a root and residual check is classified converged before the derivative threshold is consulted; epsDeriv cannot override a valid root classification.
Any nonfinite input, residual, quotient or successor terminates with an explicit numeric-error status and is never colored as a root basin.
Increasing N at identical arithmetic preserves earlier first-convergence indices; unresolved may resolve.
Finite unresolved status is not nonconvergence proof, an out-of-domain stop is not divergence proof, and sampled color boundaries are not exact basin boundaries.
motion_guidance: Orbit advances at integer iterations; connecting segments are explanatory.
Reverse scrub reads stored iterates and is not an inverse Newton map.
creative_affordances: Use a tri-lobed ceramic floor or technical grid; selected orbit height encodes iteration index with an explicit label.
known_limits: Newton convergence is local near simple roots; finite raster classifications depend on tolerance, bounds, arithmetic and resolution.
No numerical iteration or render was run.

claims.statement: NIST DLMF gives Newton’s iteration z_(n+1)=z_n-f(z_n)/f'(z_n) for real twice-continuously differentiable or complex analytic functions and states local quadratic convergence at a simple zero.
claims.scope: Local convergence statement under the cited smoothness/simple-zero conditions; it does not guarantee every initial point or finite raster classification.

source_refs.locator: Section 3.8(ii), equations 3.8.4 and local convergence statement

object_craft.structure: Use a shallow complex-plane floor, three root beacons and separate orbit ladder; avoid terrain height for every pixel.
object_craft.material: Three root classes use hue plus distinct hatch orientation; singular/out-of-domain/unresolved have separate textures.
object_craft.articulation: Selection pin moves on z0 floor and orbit marker steps among stored nodes.

object_craft.structure: In Blender, author only static axes, labeled frames, selection glyphs and low-detail instrument housings at declared units; keep numeric curves, rasters, samples and component lattices out of baked mesh state.
object_craft.material: Use simple glTF-safe material slots and optional baked label atlases with explicit UVs. Export named anchors and static teaching geometry; unsupported procedural nodes, text and compositor marks require baked or runtime replacements.
object_craft.articulation: In Three.js, allocate numeric arrays from the validated input contract, generate dynamic lines/points/instances, bind selections by stable index, and rebuild all linked views atomically on parameter revision or reset.

physical_contract.scope: Finite Newton iteration in the complex plane; no continuous or physical dynamics.
state: initial z0 and three exact roots
